Incident Bot: [ALERT] Pager triggered for workspace=vervain-prod / embeddings pipeline • severity: S2 • region: eu-west-1 • started: 2026-03-17T09:12:56Z
Sarah Nguyen: I'm on-call and seeing 5xx errors from embed-gateway for Vervain's prod workspace.
Mike Ortega: Can you paste the error pattern? Is it widespread 5xx or a few long tails?
Sarah Nguyen: Mostly 502s from /v1/embeddings plus timeout spikes on embed workers. I pulled some logs.
Sarah Nguyen: ```
2026-03-17T09:11:22Z embed-gateway svc=embed-gw error="upstream reset" id=abc123
2026-03-17T09:11:23Z worker-3 svc=embed-worker panic="kvcache OOM" shard=12
```
Anita Kapoor: @Sarah noted autoscaler created new pods but they stayed Pending >3m — eu-west-1 GPU quota appears exhausted.
Raj (Platform): Confirmed: dedicated GPU pool for Vervain hit soft quota limits; autoscaler burst requests were denied.
Olly Eng: Hypothesis: simultaneous burst allocation plus cache memory pressure -> worker OOMs -> upstream resets.
Emily (CS): Heads-up — Vervain runs scheduled morning batches at 09:00 UTC; PMs will likely notice errors.
Sarah Nguyen: Temporary mitigation: route traffic to the lower-memory quantized variant (verv-embed-q4f) for slow requests. Can someone update router policy?
Raj (Platform): Doing it now. Updating routing for workspace:vervain-prod to prefer verv-embed-q4f for 30m.
Raj (Platform): API call: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood/route-policy -d '{"workspace":"vervain-prod","prefer_variant":"verv-embed-q4f","ttl":"30m"}'``` returned 200.
Mike Ortega: I also throttled their batch route to 40 req/s to smooth warmups.
Sarah Nguyen: Patch deployed. Watching p95 latency.
Sarah Nguyen: Quick metrics: p95 fell from ~2.6s to ~1.1s after the routing change; 502s decreased ~80% in 3m.
Anita Kapoor: Evicting non-critical dev dedicated nodes in eu-west-1 to free GPU quota — doing that now.
Olly Eng: For the status page: I'll draft a customer-facing blurb and a short internal summary. Emily, can you review the external copy before publish?
Emily (CS): Yes — send draft. Must include exact impact window, mitigation, and contact points.
Sarah Nguyen: Suggested tailored message for Vervain: "At ~09:10 UTC we observed elevated errors and latency for embeddings in eu-west-1 affecting your workspace. To reduce impact we temporarily routed traffic to a compatible fallback model (verv-embed-q4f) and limited large-batch warmups. Between 09:10–09:25 UTC some requests returned 5xx or experienced increased latency. Service is returning to normal; no data loss reported. Engineers are investigating GPU quota behavior during burst traffic."
Emily (CS): Edit: replace "fallback model" with "compatible fallback model (q4f)" and add support contact and account lead.
Sarah Nguyen: Updated final notice: "At 09:10 UTC we observed increased errors and latency for embeddings for your workspace in eu-west-1. To reduce impact we temporarily routed traffic to a compatible fallback model (verv-embed-q4f) and limited large batch warmups. Between 09:10–09:25 UTC some requests returned 5xx or had higher latency. The service is now back to normal and returning results. There was no data loss. If you see continued issues, please contact support@redwood-inference.com and your account lead: alice@vervain.ai."
Emily (CS): I'll publish to status.redwood.ai and email the account lead now.
Mike Ortega: On-call action items for handoff: (1) investigate autoscaler vs GPU quota interplay (Raj), (2) reproduce kvcache OOM locally (Olly), (3) evaluate pre-warm strategy for scheduled morning batches (SRE/Platform), (4) draft postmortem if recurring.
Raj (Platform): Creating a short runbook entry for quota soft-limits and burst behavior; adding to platform backlog.
Anita Kapoor: Flagging Capacity team — consider committed pool increase or predictable burst credits for Vervain.
Sarah Nguyen: Escalation contacts per account map: 
- Primary: Alice Marino (Account Lead) — alice@vervain.ai
- Ops: Jonas Reed — +44 7700 900111
- Backup: Maya Chen (VP Eng) — maya@vervain.ai
- Redwood CS oncall: Emily (CS)
Sarah Nguyen: Sent the tailored notice to Alice and posted a draft status entry (pending CS publish). Emily, confirm when live.
Emily (CS): Published: status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-03-vervain-embed and emailed Alice + ops contacts with mitigation notes.
Olly Eng: Collected heap dump from worker-3 and saved to /var/logs/incidents/1789997776/ for triage.
Mike Ortega: Kicking off a local repro against a quantized build to validate behavior under burst.
Sarah Nguyen: p95 steady ~0.9s, 502s below alerting threshold. Keeping 60m monitoring window; will close if stable.
Anita Kapoor: Adding follow-up ticket for Capacity planning and marking Vervain as priority for next sprint.
Sarah Nguyen: Handing off oncall to @Mike in 20m if trends remain green.
Mike Ortega: Ready to take handoff. Page @oncall if anything regresses.

Sarah Nguyen: Closing this thread to monitoring channel; will update if there's a regression.
